transcode.title: Convert to save space
transcode.crfLowBitrate: Low bitrate — already compressed, conservative settings recommended
transcode.crfVeryLowBitrate: Very low bitrate — file size may increase
transcode.timeEstimate: * On Intel i5, expect 15–30 min per GB (varies by preset and CRF)
transcode.trashOriginal: Move the original file to Trash after conversion
transcode.trashOriginalNote: The converted file's duration and number of video, audio, subtitle and attachment tracks are verified first; the original is moved to Trash (never permanently deleted) only if the checks pass. On volumes where Trash is unavailable (e.g. external storage), it is moved into a ".ChuckSnapStackTrash" folder in the same directory with a ".trashed" suffix. If verification fails or the original is modified during conversion, it is kept. Playlists and watch history are not carried over.
transcode.trashOriginalDone: Moved the original file to Trash
transcode.trashOriginalQuarantined: Trash was unavailable, so the original file was moved aside (delete it manually if no longer needed): {{location}}
transcode.trashOriginalSkipped: Kept the original file because the converted file could not be added to the library
transcode.queueNote: Another video is being transcoded. Queued videos are processed in order after the current one finishes (position {{count}}). The queue is cleared when the app quits.
transcode.alreadyQueued: This video is already being transcoded or waiting in the queue.
transcode.sourceMissing: Source file not found (it may have been moved or deleted while queued)
transcode.discarded: {{name}} only shrank by {{percent}}%, so the converted file was discarded and the original was kept
transcode.estimateAlreadyAv1: This file is already AV1. Converting it will barely reduce its size.
transcode.estimateLowBitrate: The bitrate is already low ({{codec}} {{resolution}} · {{kbps}} kbps), so converting is unlikely to save much space.
transcode.discardNote: If the converted file is not at least {{percent}}% smaller than the original, it is discarded and the original is kept. All audio and subtitle tracks are preserved (cover art excluded).
transcode.encoder_audio: Video kept as is + Opus (large audio only)
transcode.estimateAlreadyEfficient: This file is already {{codec}}. Converting it to HEVC will barely make it smaller.
transcode.hevcUnavailable: HEVC (VideoToolbox) isn't available in this ffmpeg. An ffmpeg built for macOS is required.
transcode.av1Unavailable: This ffmpeg has no AV1 encoder (SVT-AV1 / libaom).
transcode.av1AomNote: This ffmpeg doesn't include SVT-AV1, so libaom will be used. Expect it to take several to ten times longer than SVT-AV1.
transcode.hevcDesc: Uses your Mac's hardware, so it finishes much faster than AV1. At the same quality, files are larger than AV1.
transcode.hevcBitrateHint: Relative to the original video. Lower is smaller but lower quality
transcode.hevcNoBitrate: The original video bitrate is unknown, so it can't be converted to HEVC.
transcode.audioDesc: Leaves the video untouched and converts only PCM, lossless, or high-bitrate audio to Opus. Audio that is already small is kept as is.
transcode.audioNothing: No audio tracks can be shrunk (already Opus or low enough bitrate).
transcode.audioNone: This file has no audio tracks.
transcode.remuxDesc: No re-encoding, so quality is unchanged. Remove tracks you don't need or cut off the start and end.
transcode.streamDropped: Removed because MKV can't hold it
transcode.trimHint: Leave blank for the start / end (total {{duration}})
transcode.trimNote: Cuts happen at keyframes, so the start may move a few seconds earlier.
transcode.trimBeyond: The end is past the video length ({{duration}}).
transcode.trimTooShort: The range to keep is too short.
transcode.remuxNothing: Remove a track or set a range to keep.
transcode.discardNoteSmall: If the converted file isn't smaller than the original, it is discarded and the original is kept.
transcode.dropSilentDesc: Removes only the audio tracks found to be silent. Nothing is re-encoded, so video and other audio stay as they are.
transcode.silenceFound: {{count}} silent audio track(s) found and unchecked.

storage.title: Storage cleanup
storage.unknownNote: {{count}} files could not be measured and are not included in the total.
storage.missingNote: {{count}} missing files are not included in the total.
storage.thumbsDesc: Removes thumbnails of files no longer in the library, and large thumbnails that are full copies of animations. Large thumbnails are regenerated as still images.
storage.kindDescLarge: Files taking up the most space.
storage.kindDescUnwatched: Unrated files never played or opened, added more than {{days}} days ago.
storage.kindDescStaleInbox: Files left in the inbox for more than {{days}} days.
storage.kindDescLongUnviewed: Files last seen more than {{days}} days ago.
storage.confirmDesc: The selected files ({{size}} total) will be moved to the Trash and removed from the library. Disk space is freed when you empty the Trash.
storage.trashFailed: {{count}} files could not be moved to the Trash
storage.trashError: Failed to move to the Trash: {{error}}
storage.kindDescHighBitrate: Videos at {{mbps}} Mbps or more. Converting them to AV1 or HEVC is likely to shrink them a lot (.av1.mkv and .hevc.mkv files converted by this app are excluded).
storage.kindDescDuplicates: Files with identical content, and files that look alike and have almost the same length, grouped together. Select everything except "Keep" to free up space.
storage.dupShowing: Showing the {{shown}} groups that free the most space
storage.dupKeepOne: One file in each group is kept
storage.dupPhashMissing: {{count}} files have no pHash for visual comparison yet. Compute it to also find similar duplicates.
storage.trashDesc: Files moved to the Trash keep using disk space until the Trash is emptied. On drives without a Trash, conversion sources are moved to a holding folder (.ChuckSnapStackTrash) in the same folder.
storage.trashOsUnknownHint: On macOS, the Trash can't be read without Full Disk Access. Empty the Trash in Finder to free up space.
storage.trashOsHint: Empty the Trash in Finder to free up space.
storage.trashEmptyConfirmDesc: {{count}} files ({{size}} in total) in the holding folders will be permanently deleted. This can't be undone.
storage.batchDesc: The selected videos ({{size}} in total) will be added to the conversion queue.
storage.batchQueued: Added {{count}} files to the conversion queue
storage.batchSkipped: {{count}} files are already in the conversion queue
storage.batchCrfNote: CRF is chosen for each video from its bitrate.
storage.confirmDescDup: The selected files will be moved to the Trash and removed from the library. Emptying the Trash should free about {{size}} (space shared by APFS clones is not freed).
storage.dupCloneNote: Some files are APFS clones (copies that share their data). Deleting one clone frees almost no space, so the space to free is an estimate that leaves that out.
storage.dupCloneHint: Shares its data with the files that have the same number. Deleting only one of them frees almost no space
storage.leftoverDesc: Interrupted yt-dlp downloads (.part etc.), temporary transcode files left after a crash, and interrupted AI model downloads. Searches watched folders, the download folder and folders that contain library files, and only lists files not modified for over an hour.
storage.leftoverShowing: Showing the {{shown}} largest. Deleting removes the files shown
storage.leftoverConfirmDesc: The files shown ({{size}} in total) will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
storage.aiDesc: Models downloaded for AI tag suggestions. Delete the ones you don't use to free space (you can reinstall them from Settings).
storage.aiRemoveConfirmDesc: The model files ({{size}}) will be deleted.
storage.aiRemoveConfirmDescInUse: The model files ({{size}}) will be deleted. This model is used for AI tag suggestions, so it will need to be downloaded again next time.
storage.aiRemoveError: Could not delete the AI model: {{error}}
storage.kindDescSilentAudio: Videos whose audio tracks contain only silence (screen recordings, muted exports, etc.). Removing the silent tracks frees space without touching the video.
storage.silenceUnchecked: {{count}} videos haven't been checked for silent audio yet. Check them to list any here.
storage.silenceFailed: Couldn't read {{count}} files (will retry next time)
storage.silentSummary: {{count}} files · about {{size}} freed by removing them
